question: A follower of Gokhale, Narayan Malhar Joshi founded the Social Service League in Bombay, in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1911**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Narayan Malhar Joshi, a follower of Gokhale, founded the Social Service League in Bombay in 1911.
 
• The league's goals were to improve the working and living conditions of the masses.&am
